seo.description: Discover Fint Oasis near Ouarzazate: green palm corridor and village life — softer contrast to kasbahs and film sets.
seo.keywords: Fint Oasis, Oasis de Fint, Ouarzazate oasis

name: Fint Oasis
hero_subtitle: Palm oasis and village lanes south of Ouarzazate — greenery beyond the film sets.

overview.title: Green against the dry hills
overview.p1: Fint Oasis offers palm gardens, irrigation channels and village paths instead of studio façades.
overview.p2: Often arranged with a driver. Respect private gardens and ask before photographing people.

gallery.title: Fint Oasis
gallery.subtitle: Palm oasis and village lanes south of Ouarzazate — greenery beyond the film sets.

moods.title: Fint through the day
moods.subtitle: Shade under palms is more forgiving than open desert.

1.title: Fresh start
1.desc: Pleasant walking temperatures in the groves.

2.title: Still shaded
2.desc: Palms help; keep an easy pace at midday.

3.title: Warm light on palms
3.desc: Nice for photos on the return toward town.

food.title: Eat around Fint
food.p1: Simple hospitality may be offered on tours. Otherwise plan meals in Ouarzazate.
food.p2: Landscape and village visit more than a dining destination.

2.title: Respect
2.desc: Stay on paths; ask before photos of people.

3.title: Footwear
3.desc: Closed shoes for dusty or uneven paths.

q3.question: Good for children?
q3.answer: Yes at an easy pace in the shade.

q4.question: Same day as Aït Benhaddou?
q4.answer: Possible but full — many prefer a separate half-day.

q5.question: What makes it special?
q5.answer: Water and palms so close to the dry plateau.
